articles.title: Armadillo-Inspired Robot Curls Up to Protect Fragile Tech
articles.summary: Engineers at NC State built a soft robot that rolls into a protective ball when touched, mimicking the three-banded armadillo. It could shield electronics in dangerous places like deep oceans or volcanoes.

articles.title: Harvest Moon and Saturn Team Up in the Night Sky This Weekend
articles.summary: The Harvest Moon, the first full moon of autumn, rises Sept. 26 and 27 alongside Saturn. Look east after sunset — no telescope required for this celestial pairing.

articles.title: Burning Scrolls to Read the Unreadable: A 2,000-Year-Old Mystery
articles.summary: Scientists burned their own papyrus scrolls to test a new way to read ancient charred ones from Herculaneum. Lead in the ink shows up on X-rays, potentially unlocking a lost library without opening it.
